mapper.select: SELECT A.LOT_ID,A.PRODSPEC_ID,A.LOT_PROC_STATE,A.CASSETE_ID ,A.WAFER_QTY,A.NENG_FLAG,A.XFER_STATE,A.MIN_SHIFT_DATE,A.MAX_SHIFT_DATE ,A.LAST_OP,A.RUN_COUNT,A.PRODG1,A.PRODG_OWNER,A.PRODG_DEPT_ID ,A.PRODG_EMP_ID,A.HOLD_DEPT_CNAME,A.HOLD_COMMENT,A.HOLD_CNAME ,A.REMAIN_QTIME,A.LOT_EMP_ID,A.LOT_OWNER,A.LOT_DEPT_ID,A.LOT_DEPT_CNAME ,B.FCST_DONE_TIME,A.FORCE_EQP_ID FROM A1MFG.N2_PURGE_INFO_HOURLY A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME, KEY1 LOT_ID,KEY2 FCST_DONE_TIME FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'N2_PURGE' )B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID WHERE A.LOCATION = #{location,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY A.REMAIN_QTIME

SELECT A.LOT_ID,A.PRODSPEC_ID,A.LOT_PROC_STATE,A.CASSETE_ID ,A.WAFER_QTY,A.NENG_FLAG,A.XFER_STATE,A.MIN_SHIFT_DATE,A.MAX_SHIFT_DATE ,A.LAST_OP,A.RUN_COUNT,A.PRODG1,A.PRODG_OWNER,A.PRODG_DEPT_ID ,A.PRODG_EMP_ID,A.HOLD_DEPT_CNAME,A.HOLD_COMMENT,A.HOLD_CNAME ,A.REMAIN_QTIME,A.LOT_EMP_ID,A.LOT_OWNER,A.LOT_DEPT_ID,A.LOT_DEPT_CNAME ,B.FCST_DONE_TIME,A.FORCE_EQP_ID FROM A1MFG.N2_PURGE_INFO_HOURLY A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME, KEY1 LOT_ID,KEY2 FCST_DONE_TIME FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'N2_PURGE' )B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID WHERE A.LOCATION = #{location,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NENG_FLAG = 0 AND RUN_COUNT >10 AND REMAIN_QTIME <-100 AND SUBSTR(PRODG1,2,2) IN('28','40') AND A.FORCE_EQP_ID IS NULL ORDER BY A.REMAIN_QTIME

WITH DATE_LIST AS( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)-ROWNUM+1,'YYYYMMDD')SHIFT_DATE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY ROWNUM <=31 ) SELECT A.SHIFT_DATE ,B.TOTAL_COUNT ,B.FORCE_COUNT ,CASE WHEN NVL(TOTAL_COUNT,0)-NVL(B.FORCE_COUNT,0)>0 THEN NVL(TOTAL_COUNT,0)-NVL(B.FORCE_COUNT,0) END REMAIN_COUNT FROM DATE_LIST A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,TOTAL_COUNT,FORCE_COUNT FROM A1MFG.N2_PURGE_INFO_SUMMARY WHERE LOCATION = #{location,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT SHIFT_DATE,COUNT(1)TOTAL_COUNT,SUM(FROCE_FLAG)FORCE_COUNT FROM( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') SHIFT_DATE,LOT_ID ,CASE WHEN FORCE_EQP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END FROCE_FLAG FROM A1MFG.N2_PURGE_INFO_HOURLY WHERE LOCATION = #{location,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NENG_FLAG = 0 AND RUN_COUNT >10 AND REMAIN_QTIME <-100 AND SUBSTR(PRODG1,2,2) IN('28','40') )GROUP BY SHIFT_DATE )B ON A.SHIFT_DATE = B.SHIFT_DATE ORDER BY A.SHIFT_DATE
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY A USING( SELECT 'N2_PURGE' FUNCTION_NAME,#{lotId} LOT_ID,#{fcstDoneTime} FCST_DONE_TIME,#{updateUser} UPDATE_USER,SYSDATE UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL )B ON (A.FUNCTION_NAME = B.FUNCTION_NAME AND A.KEY1 = B.LOT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.UPDATE_TIME =B.UPDATE_TIME,A.UPDATE_USER=B.UPDATE_USER,A.KEY2 = B.FCST_DONE_TIME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FUNCTION_NAME, KEY1, KEY2,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME)VALUES(B.FUNCTION_NAME, B.LOT_ID, B.FCST_DONE_TIME,B.UPDATE_USER,B.UPDATE_TIME)
